turn_structure.end_of_round: discard remaining, draw up to 5; monsters do not discard
turn_structure.handshake_scope: players sharing adjacent tiles sync face-down cards each turn; same-dimension players sync once per turn end

narrative_order_rules: first player in contact = 'youngest' player label
later arrivals slot in by proximity / contact order
a monster slots immediately after the character that discovered it

resolution_matrix.empty_resolution_rule: Empty Posture carries no bonus and no damage of its own. For resolution, the enemy chooses which empty-type to treat it as (rule 6): an enemy with Attack treats EP as Posture (Attack beats Posture → EP takes 1); an enemy with Posture treats EP as Empty Move (Posture beats Move → EP takes 1). Enemies playing Move or Block pick the empty-type that neutralises the match, so Move-vs-EP and Block-vs-EP resolve as neutral. Empty Move resolves symmetrically: Block treats it as Move (Move loses to Block → EM takes 1).

edges.note: defender A also takes -1 damage dealt
enemy with Attack treats EP as Posture → attack still hits, EP takes 1
enemy with Posture treats EP as Empty Move → posture beats move, EP takes 1
mirror of A-vs-EP: EP actor takes 1 damage
mirror of P-vs-EP: EP actor takes 1 damage
enemy with Block treats EM as Move → block beats move, EM takes 1
mirror of B-vs-EM: EM actor takes 1 damage

resolution_matrix.empty_posture_vs_attack: ep takes -1 damage; attack still hits (now encoded as edge A→EP)
resolution_matrix.empty_move_vs_block: em takes -1 damage; block still hits (now encoded as edge B→EM)

resolution_math.effect_damage_formula: round_half_up( Σ max(stat_caster - stat_defender, 0) / 10 )   // 0.5→1, 0.4→0 — see rule_21
resolution_math.life: round_half_up( Σstats / 10 )   // 40 → 4; 80 → 8; both exact so rounding is moot
resolution_math.point_buy: roll N d6 whose sum ≤ stat; keep highest die as token value
resolution_math.stat_buy: accumulate caster stat per emission across turns until target total; used by Summoning/Elementals/Golems/Resurrect

movement_and_range.attack_follow: optional free-chase that mirrors enemy's Move toward their next tile (Rule 15)
movement_and_range.range_extensions_from_terrain: towers / outposts grant chess-like 2-3 tile reach per building

token_types: shield_token: colorless die on tile; extra life; cumulative
stat_penalty_token: wooden die under stat number; subtracts
permanent_token: colored die over a stat; adds
tile_token: large colored die right of tile; bonuses all creatures on tile
status_handling.lock_condition: a trap or monster can lock your character; counts as 1 re-entry attempt lost
